_note: Lotto NZ's own media releases - the operator, not a news site. Titles, dates, links and standfirsts only: enough to cite and link a release. Article text is always written from scratch from the facts, never adapted from Lotto NZ's wording.

releases.title: More Powerballs, more prizes coming 13 September
releases.standfirst: Lotto NZ has revealed fresh details of its Powerball overhaul, including information on the new prizes that will be up for grabs and confirmation of a launch on Sunday 13 September.

releases.title: Calling all West Aucklanders – have you won $20 million?
releases.standfirst: Lotto NZ is calling on West Aucklanders to dig out and check their tickets – a huge $20 million Powerball prize won more than three weeks ago remains unclaimed.

releases.title: Lotto NZ to delay release of winning ticket locations until next morning
releases.standfirst: Lotto NZ is giving players more time to check if they’re a big winner by delaying the release of winner location information until the morning after each draw.

releases.title: More chances to win as Lotto NZ unveils changes to Powerball
releases.standfirst: Lotto NZ says new improvements to its flagship Powerball game will increase the number of prize divisions and the likelihood of winning a prize in each draw.

releases.title: Ever wondered what happens behind the scenes of a live Lotto draw?
releases.standfirst: In our special feature with Seven Sharp, Hilary Barry steps inside the draw studio for an exclusive look at what really happens before those winning numbers appear on screen.

releases.title: Lotto NZ returns near-record $395 million to community
releases.standfirst: A series of large Powerball jackpots sits behind the FY25 return, the second highest amount in the history of the Government-operated lottery.

releases.title: Lotto NZ partners with NZ Team for Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games
releases.standfirst: The New Zealand Team and Lotto NZ build on the momentum from their Paris 2024 campaign.
